semantic_label: palette row layout: chain the lead, feature title and body rectangles down a stacked column using the 0x01486110 row gap and the tail or host edge

abi.calling_convention: thiscall, receiver only, no stack arguments
abi.frame: SUB ESP,0x18 / PUSH EBX / PUSH ESI; the receiver is copied to ESI and no callee-saved register beyond EBX/ESI is used
abi.return_contract: void; the entry never writes EAX and ends at 0x005c31b6 with a plain RET

instruction_list: 0x005c3007 row_span = [ESI+0x78] - [ESI+0x74]; AND EAX,0xfffffffc; SETGE BL  (stacked when the cleared span is at least 4)
0x005c300d PUSH 0x1 / PUSH 0x5d3f56b / MOV ECX,[ESI+0x10] / CALL 0x008105b0 / SETNZ [ESP+0xb]
0x005c3027 group_span = [EAX+0x10] - [EAX+0xc]; AND ECX,0xfffffffc; CMP ECX,0x4 / CMP byte [EAX+0x70],0  (wide group)
0x005c304d MOV EDX,[0x015fd918] / MOV EAX,[EDX+0x3c] / CMP [EAX+0x118],0 / CALL 0x005c2aa0 / CMP EAX,0x1 / XOR BL,BL  (application flag clears the stacked decision)
0x005c306d MOVSS XMM0,[0x01486110] / MOVSS [ESP+0xc],XMM0  (offset seed is the row gap global)
0x005c307b TEST BL,BL / JZ 0x005c30a0 / MOV ECX,[ESI+0x20] / vtable slot +0x38 / MOVSS XMM0,[EAX+0xc] / ADDSS XMM0,[0x01486110]  (lead height raises the offset)
0x005c30a0 CMP byte [ESP+0xb],0 / JZ 0x005c3117 / MOV ECX,[ESI+0x24] / vtable slot +0x38 / build {x, offset, w, (h - y) + offset} / vtable slot +0x6c / offset = rect.h + gap
0x005c3117 MOV ECX,[ESI+0x28] / TEST ECX,ECX / JZ 0x005c31b1  (null body stops the pass)
0x005c3122 body bounds; wide and host at +0x1c gives rect.h = host.y - gap
0x005c317c otherwise tail at +0x2c gives rect.h = (tail.h - tail.y) - gap
0x005c31a2 MOV ECX,[ESI+0x28] / vtable slot +0x6c with LEA EDX,[ESP+0x10]  (apply the body rectangle)

mechanics: compute the row span from the rows vector at +0x74/+0x78 and clear the low two bits
set the stacked decision when the cleared span is greater than or equal to 4
query the feature port 0x008105b0 with the fixed feature id 0x05d3f56b and count 1, on the feature host at +0x10
derive the wide decision from the group vector at group+0x0c/+0x10 cleared by 0xfffffffc, greater than 4, or the group byte at +0x70
clear the stacked decision when the application property flag at +0x118 is nonzero and the distinct row port 0x005c2aa0 returns below 1
seed the running offset from the row gap global 0x01486110
when stacked and the lead at +0x20 is non null, raise the offset to lead height plus the gap
when the feature is present and the title at +0x24 is non null, apply a rectangle of {x, offset, w, (h - y) + offset} and continue the chain from the applied height plus the gap
when the body at +0x28 is null, return without touching any element
when wide and the host at +0x1c is non null, take the body height from host.y minus the gap
otherwise when the tail at +0x2c is non null, take the body height from (tail.h - tail.y) minus the gap
apply the body rectangle through the element vtable slot +0x6c exactly once
